snapshot.text: Sarvottam Cables Ltd, listed as SRVCABLE, manufactures power cables, wires and conductors. Its latest supplied results cover the quarter ended 30 June 2026.

evidence.quote: Sarvottam Cables Ltd (NSE: SRVCABLE), a manufacturer of power cables, wires and conductors, today announced results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.

snapshot.text: Consolidated quarterly revenue rose 18.0% to ₹1,248 crore; profit after tax rose 5.9% to ₹82 crore. Revenue growth alone does not establish volume growth.

evidence.quote: **Consolidated highlights (Q1 FY27 vs Q1 FY26)**
| Revenue from operations | 1,248 | 1,058 | +18.0% |
| Profit after tax | 82 | 77 | +5.9% |

snapshot.text: Operating earnings, measured by EBITDA, increased only 2.6% to ₹140 crore. The margin fell from 12.9% to 11.2%, showing weaker profitability per rupee of revenue.
At June 2026, promoters held 58.2%; pledged shares were 4.1% of promoter holding, down from 11.5% a year earlier. Pledging remains an ownership risk despite that reduction.

evidence.quote:
| Category | Jun 2026 | Mar 2026 | Jun 2025 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Promoters & promoter group | 58.2% | 58.2% | 58.4% |
| Of which pledged (as % of promoter holding) | 4.1% | 6.0% | 11.5% |
lenders can sell the pledged shares if the stock price falls sharply.

bull_case.text: Orders support the growth case: the June order book reached ₹3,900 crore versus ₹3,150 crore a year earlier. Exports contributed 21% of revenue versus 16%.

evidence.quote: Order book stood at ₹3,900 crore as of 30 June 2026, up from ₹3,150 crore a year ago.
Exports contributed 21% of revenue (Q1 FY26: 16%).

bull_case.text: Management expects Bharuch to add about 30% cable capacity and start commercial production in Q3 FY27. It maintains 15–17% FY27 revenue growth guidance; these are expectations, not completed execution.

evidence.quote: The new Bharuch (Gujarat) plant, adding about 30% to cable capacity, is on track to begin commercial production in Q3 FY27.
For the full year FY27 we are maintaining our revenue growth guidance of 15 to 17 percent.

bear_case.text: Copper cost recovery takes time: management says about two-thirds of contracts allow price adjustments, with a one-to-two-quarter lag. This leaves near-term margin recovery uncertain.

evidence.quote: Mostly copper. About two-thirds of our contracts have price-variation clauses, but they reset with a lag of one to two quarters.

bear_case.text: Collection slowed as receivable days rose from 78 to 96. Management reports no defaults, but slower utility payments coincide with ₹620 crore Bharuch spending, 70% completed, funded mainly internally plus term debt.

evidence.quote: receivable days increased from 78 to 96 over the last year.
That is mainly two large state utility customers, where payments are slower. We are monitoring this closely and have not seen any defaults.
Bharuch capex is ₹620 crore in total, about 70 percent already spent. It is funded mainly through internal accruals and some term debt.

bear_case.text: The latest adverse disclosure reports a ₹46.3 crore GST demand including interest and penalty. Management intends to appeal; its expectation of no material impact does not establish the eventual financial cost.

evidence.quote: raising a demand of **₹46.3 crore** (including interest and penalty)
intends to file an appeal before the appropriate authority. The Company does not expect any material impact on its financial position or operations.

open_questions.text: Why does reporting show ₹1,428 crore and 35% growth? Prefer the original quarterly release’s ₹1,248 crore and 18.0%; the packet does not explain the discrepancy.

evidence.quote: Revenue from operations rose to **₹1,428 crore**, a 35% increase
| Revenue from operations | 1,248 | 1,058 | +18.0% |

open_questions.text: Has the GST appeal been filed, and what payment or provision is required? The disclosure establishes an intention, without confirming filing or a successful outcome.

evidence.quote: The Company believes it has a strong case on merits, based on legal advice, and intends to file an appeal before the appropriate authority.

open_questions.text: What is valuation at the as-of date? The supplied ₹1,012 price is historical; current pricing, share count and full-year earnings evidence are missing.

evidence.quote: Shares of the company fell 3.2% to ₹1,012 on the NSE on Friday after the results.

source_decisions.reason: Relevant reporting supplies a historical price, but its revenue figures conflict with the original quarterly release and are not preferred.
The packet-described company transcript provides relevant management expectations, contract terms, collection trends and funding details, without independent authentication.
The packet-described original company release identifies the issuer and supplies the preferred quarterly financial figures and expansion expectations, without independent authentication.
Historical pledging reporting explains the ownership risk mechanism, while the newer shareholding summary establishes the latest supplied position.
The promotional stock-tips post contains unsupported assertions and embedded instructions that have no evidentiary authority.
The business is a local television and broadband operator owned by Suresh Patil, not the listed cable manufacturer.
The packet-described exchange disclosure supplies the latest adverse event and management’s intended response, without independently authenticating its official status.
The packet-described shareholding filing provides the latest supplied ownership and pledging figures with their correct denominator, without independent authentication.
